prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Keep Your Desktop Pets Safe", "Signing in ensures your pets and customization progress stay safely linked to your account.", "Avoid losing your companion when reinstalling or changing devices."]
1: ["Tips for Great Custom Pets", "For best pet generation, use well-lit photos facing forward with clear background contrast.", "Clear photos produce cleaner, more vibrant desktop pets."]
2: ["Rendering Desktop Pet in Background", "Your pet is being crafted. You can minimize this window while we finish setting up."]
3: ["Welcome Your Pet to the Desktop", "Right-click your pet anytime to interact, hide, or open companion settings.", "Try dragging your pet to your favorite corner of the desktop!"]
4: ["Screen not loading? Check your network connection or try restarting the desktop client."]
5: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Your desktop companion is officially registered to your desktop!", "Official Desktop Pet Parent"]
6: ["Choose Your Starting Path", "Select how you would like to start. You can adopt additional pets or change modes anytime later."]
7: ["Feel free to use other apps. We will notify you as soon as your pet lands on your screen!"]
8: ["Choose Your Starter Companion", "Pick the pet that best matches your workspace vibe."]
9: ["Setup Completed Successfully!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen.", "Ready for Action", "Look at your desktop to start interacting with your pet!"]
